result.title: FACET: Feasibility-Automaton Complete Enumeration and Truncation-Free Scoring of Molecular Formulas from MS/MS
result.summary: Determining the neutral molecular formula of a precursor ion from its tandem mass (MS/MS) spectrum is the first step in identifying an unknown small molecule. Existing methods trade recall, whether the correct formula is among the candidates, against the cost of examining each candidate. Methods that examine each candidate in depth must first shorten the list, by limiting element counts or truncating it, and that is where the correct formula is lost. End-to-end regressors are fast but guarantee neither validity nor recall. We present FACET, which separates deciding which formulas to consider from deciding which one to choose. A feasibility automaton builds a formula one element count at a time and admits exactly the formulas that fit the precursor mass and satisfy the ring-and-double-bond and valence constraints. Run as an exhaustive search, it enumerates the complete feasible set, so every candidate is valid and recall is fixed by the chemical constraints rather than by a trained model. A small neural scoring head then ranks every feasible formula from one pass of a pretrained spectrum encoder, so no candidate is discarded. On the NPLIB1 benchmark FACET reaches top-1 accuracies of $0.859$ with the adduct known and $0.729$ with it unknown, compared with $0.766$ and $0.660$ for the strongest established method, and its recall is the highest. On the external CASMI 2022 set its recall is $1.000$, and with the adduct unknown it is the most accurate of the methods compared.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FACET，将「决定考虑哪些候选分子式」与「决定选哪一个」解耦：用可行性自动机按元素计数逐步构造，穷举满足母离子质量与价键约束的全部可行式，再由小型神经打分头基于一次谱图编码器前向对全候选排序，在 NPLIB1 与 CASMI 2022 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「完整枚举候选、不截断地对全部候选打分」的解耦思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中多 latent 假设生成与视觉证据筛选、以及避免早期剪枝造成信息坍缩的问题；但研究领域为质谱分子式识别，与视觉推理仅有方法层面的间接联系。
